encoding_variations: Employment status stated as "Active", "Currently employed", or "Full-time, in good standing" — all mean active; map to the status, keep the snippet

The phone source is the crux: "obtained from 411", "employer main line per company website", or "HR direct line provided by borrower" carry very different independence weight — always pair employer_phone_used with phone_source
Verifier authority appears as a title ("HR Manager") or a relationship phrase ("borrower's supervisor") — keep whichever is stated in verifier_relationship_or_authority

notes: No rules read this document today (rule floor is empty); fields are justified by identity, disambiguation, and processor use. A Verbal VOE (VVOE) is a lender's contemporaneous record of a phone call to an employer confirming employment near closing; its value hinges on independence, recency (call date), and result.
A VVOE is a lender-authored memo, not an employer form; the "issuer" is the lender, so read the lender rep and the verifier as two distinct people.
For self-employed borrowers the VVOE is replaced by a third-party business existence check (Secretary of State, CPA letter, directory); route those to the SE-alternative fields.
